title: What Turned Up in the Packing
description:
In the middle of packing, his hands stopped.

Something left at the back of a drawer. Maybe a piece of paper. Maybe a record he had kept on a screen.

{keepsake}.

Between the day he first kept it and now, one room was coming to an end. {name} stayed still for a while, caught between the box going to the new place and what could remain here.

choices.text: Take it — there is still no reason to throw it away
choices.result_text:
He made a place for it at the top of the box.

One name remained in view: {keepsake}.

The luggage was no lighter. Still, {name} could close the box. He returned the key and opened the door to the next room.

choices.text: Leave it — decide this is where it ends
choices.result_text:
If it was paper, he threw it away. If it was a record on a screen, he deleted it.

The last name he saw: {keepsake}.

The box itself was no lighter. But when he lifted it, it felt that way. {name} went to the next room without looking back.
